name: FFS_FORM_DATA
description: Stores data provided on submit of forms.

columns.name: FORM_LABEL
columns.description: Unique text label for the form. Used as external ID.

columns.name: FORM_DATA
columns.description: Form Data Content in JSON format.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Link to the related activity ID - FFS_ACTIVITY->ACTIVITY_ID.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ID
columns.description: Reference to the related inventory ID - FFS_INVENTORY->INVENTORY_ID.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: ID of the resource the operation is performed by.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: ID of the user the operation is performed by.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_AT
columns.description: Form Submit Date and Time value.

columns.name: CREATED_AT
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
